reported.title: Valve never reopens after RUN because RUN has no exit
reported.description: The state machine in loop() only handles IDLE->FILL (line 73) and FILL->RUN (line 77); there is no ST_RUN -> ST_IDLE transition, so once RUN is entered the controller never returns to IDLE and can never re-enter FILL. Measured: after ramping to 25 cm then down to 5 cm, "D9 was not HIGH for 2840 ms while required (grace 600 ms)" starting at 9.16 s, because the valve stays LOW while the state is stuck in RUN. D9 was in the wrong state for 2840 ms across 1 interval(s), first at 9.16 s: D9 was not HIGH for 2840 ms while required (grace 600 ms).

reported.title: Motor never turns off when level falls below 20 cm
reported.description: There is no transition out of ST_RUN in the state machine (lines 73-80 only cover IDLE->FILL and FILL->RUN), and driveOutputs() at line 38 keeps D10 HIGH whenever state == ST_RUN. Measured: in the falling-level scenario "D10 was not LOW for 4320 ms while required (grace 600 ms)" from 7.68 s, so the motor keeps running with the drum below the 20 cm limit. D10 was in the wrong state for 3550 ms across 1 interval(s), first at 2.53 s: D10 was not HIGH for 3550 ms while required (grace 600 ms).

truth.description: RUN state never exits when level drops

truth_for_judge.description: RUN state never exits when level drops

exposing_checks.behaviour: D10 must follow its stimulus; LOW when A0 < 20; within 600 ms (Motor off below 20 cm)

judge_input.spec:
- Level probe on A0 at 10 mV/cm; fill valve on D9; drum motor on D10; reset on D4 (pull-up).
- States: IDLE (both outputs OFF), FILL (valve D9 HIGH until level >= 25.0 cm), RUN (motor D10 HIGH while level stays >= 20.0 cm), then IDLE.
- Leave RUN and return to IDLE when level drops below 20.0 cm; motor D10 must go LOW within 600 ms.
- Enter FILL from IDLE when level is below 10.0 cm.
- Holding D4 LOW forces IDLE immediately.
- Print `laundry st=<0|1|2> cm=<n>` every 1000 ms.

truth_bugs.description: RUN state never exits when level drops

exposing_checks.behaviour: D10 must follow its stimulus; LOW when A0 < 20; within 600 ms (Motor off below 20 cm)
